title: Bias-Aware Mislabeling Detection via Decoupled Confident Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the recall and precision of bias-aware mislabeling detection algorithms across hate speech posts targeting different sexuality groups (Bisexual, Gay, Lesbian, Straight) using a dual-label dataset with both crowdsourced and expert gold-standard annotations.

Evaluating the recall and precision of bias-aware mislabeling detection algorithms across hate speech posts targeting different racial groups (Black, Middle Eastern, White) using a dual-label dataset with both crowdsourced and expert gold-standard annotations.

Evaluating the recall and precision of bias-aware mislabeling detection algorithms across hate speech posts targeting different gender groups (Men, Women) using a dual-label dataset with both crowdsourced and expert gold-standard annotations.
